listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod that prevents a ship from being restored by the Hull Restoration skill.

description:
Hi everyone, I made a small mod that lets you prevent certain ships from being restored by the Hull Restoration skill.

What it does:
This mod adds a hullmod that makes a ship "unrestorable", meaning:
- D-mods will NOT be removed over time by Hull Restoration
- The ship behaves like special campaign ships (e.g. automated ships recovered from the Planetkiller mission)

Use cases:
- Prevent unwanted ships from being repaired, so Hull Restoration focuses on the ships you want.
- If you use Hull Restoration early on to save story points when recovering ships, you might want to keep D-mods later to benefit from Derelict Operations.
- If you use both Hull Restoration and Derelict Operations (may happen if you install A New Level of Confidence), this mod helps avoid the conflict — you can keep D-mods on capital ships for lower DP, while still letting Hull Restoration repair your smaller ships.

Download:

Download zip         |         GitHub

Save Compatibility:
- Safe to add to an existing save
- NOT safe to remove after being enabled

Mod Compatibility
- No known mod conflicts at this time.
- Compatible with the Second Command Continuous Repairs skill (v1.8.2).
